about.title: About {industry} on System News
about.description: How we choose, score, and summarize {industry} news.
about.body1: System News collects approved publisher feeds for {industry}, scores each story for relevance, and groups coverage of the same event. We publish a short original summary in the story's own language and always link to the publisher.
about.body2: We do not store article bodies or rehost images. One channel covers one industry, and every channel is available in English and Spanish without machine translation.
about.how1: Every feed is declared by language, so English and Spanish coverage are scored and deduplicated separately.
about.how2: AI writes a short summary in the story's language. If the provider is unavailable, headlines and links still publish.
about.how3: Refreshes run twice a day by default and can be forced by an operator. A rolling window keeps the desk current.
about.contact: Questions or a correction? Contact the desk.

legal.privacyBody: System News stores only what it needs to run the desk: feed metadata, article headlines and links, aggregated usage counts, and messages or lead requests you choose to send. We do not sell personal data. Lead requests are shared only with the partner for the channel you selected. Contact the desk to request an export or deletion.
legal.termsBody: System News publishes headlines, excerpts, and original summaries with attribution and links to the publisher. Content remains the property of its publisher. Nothing on this site is legal, financial, medical, or professional advice. Use of the site is at your own risk; automated access must respect the published rate limits.
